axew_line.text: Gah... That hit harder than I thought. My legs won't hold...
Sorry, everyone... Push on without me for a minute...

bagon_line.text: Nngh... No! I can still take one more hit... just let me stand...
Tch... Fine. I'm down for now, but I'm getting right back up.

gible_line.text: Ack! Okay, okay, that one actually stung... Vision's going fuzzy...
Heh... Guess I bit off too much this time. Watch yourselves out there...

dratini_line.text: Ngh... I misread that opening... My strength is slipping fast.
Stay steady, everyone... Keep your formation tight...

goomy_line.text: Oof... Everything's spinning. I tried to hold the line...
Please be careful, everyone... Don't let them hurt you...

quaxly_line.text: Whoa... My footing just gave out! My crest is a mess...
Sorry, {lord}... Tell Dad I tried to hold my stance...
I'm falling back to catch my breath... Don't lose without me!

flabebe_line.text: Ah...! My petals... I dropped my salve pouch...
I'm sorry, {lord}. I was supposed to keep everyone patched up...
I need to rest for a moment... Please stay out of danger.

mentor_quaquaval_line.text: Ghk...! Hmph, sloppy footwork on my part. Getting rusty in my old age...
Listen to me, {lord}. Keep your guard up and watch out for {partner}.
I have to step off the line for now... Show them what we practiced.

combee_line.text: Bzzzt...! Ow, ow, ow! Left wing's bent and the bottom one's seeing stars!
Wait, wait, we're losing altitude! Sorry, {lord}, we can't stay airborne...
Tell the Queen we tried our best... Zzz...

vespiquen.text: Ghh...! Insolent strike... My guard has been breached.
I must withdraw and tend my hive, {lord}. Hold the field in my stead.

chespin_line.text: Ngh...! Even my shell has its limit... My knees will not hold.
Forgive me, Commander {lord}. A shield should never crack before the line behind it.
I must yield the field for now... Please guard your flank.

machop_line.text: Gah...! Lost my grip right at the worst second...
Man, Boss Machamp would chew me out for dropping my guard like that.
Gotta sit this one out, {lord}. Finish the climb for me!

slakoth_line.text: Oof... Ow. Okay, that actually woke me up...
World's tilting sideways... Think I'll lie down right here for a bit...
Save me an Oran Berry when this is over, {lord}... *Yaaawn*...

starly_line.text: Agh! Clipped my wing... Can't catch an updraft!
Tch, grounded! Sorry, {lord}, I can't watch the sky from down here.
Pulling back before I black out... Win this for our hometown squad.

caterpie_line.text: Ugh...! That knocked the wind right out of me...
I thought I had the angle covered... Guess I misjudged that hit.
I'm pulling back to recover, {lord}. Watch the brush on your flank.

pawmi_line.text: Zzzt...! Ow! My cheeks just shorted out...
No way... My legs feel like lead. I can't keep the pace up...
Sorry, {lord}. Tag me out for now... I owe you a rematch later!

honedge_line.text: Khh...! A grievous blow... My hilt grows heavy.
Forgive this lapse in arms, {lord}. My steel fails you today.
I must withdraw to mend my edge... Guard your honor until I return.

sandile_line.text: Grrk...! Sand in my eyes... Walked right into that one!
Tch, embarrassing for a desert tracker. My legs are cooked.
I'm ducking into cover, {lord}. Don't let them flank you while I'm out.

dreepy_line.text: Tch...! Sloppy... The wind slipped right through my claws.
I have to fall back to the canopy, {lord}. Do not waste the ground we took.

deino_line.text: Grrgh...! Impossible... Taken down before the Rift is even shut?!
Move, {lord}... Don't look back at me. End this war.

eevee_line.text: Yip...! Ow, that hit way too hard...
I'm sorry, {lord}... I tried to keep up, I really did. I need to rest...

oricorio_line.text: Oh...! My rhythm broke right mid-step...
Looks like my encore has to wait, {lord}. Keep dancing past them for me!

tinkatink_line.text: Clang...! Hey, watch the hammer! Ow, my arms went numb...
Ugh, fine, I'm retreating! Next battle I'm bringing a bigger chunk of scrap!

duskull_line.text: Hsssh... The chill fades... Even shadows wear thin.
I must drift back into the dark, {lord}. Do not follow me there.

gastly_line.text: Gack...! Hey, that wasn't funny! My mist is scattering everywhere!
Okay, okay, I'm ghosting out for real this time... Don't get wiped without me!

seedot_line.text: Ngh...! Cracked my cap... Not my finest landing.
I'll roll back into the brush to recover, {lord}. Hold the treeline!

pikipek_line.text: Squawk...! Took a direct hit to the wing...
Gotta perch and catch my breath, {lord}. Watch the high ground!

abra_line.text: Mm... My focus snapped. That's my cue to blink out...
Teleporting to the back line, {lord}. Keep your head clear.

ralts_line.text: Ah...! The shock is too loud... I can't hold my focus...
I'm sorry, {lord}. Please stay safe while I recover...

solosis_line.text: Bloop... Oh dear, my barrier popped clean through...
Drifting to the rear before I lose consciousness... Good luck, {lord}.

geodude_line.text: Grah...! That actually chipped my gravel! Didn't see it coming...
Gotta roll out of the line of fire, {lord}. Smash 'em back for me!

roggenrola_line.text: Krrk...! Core rattled... Too loud, too heavy...
Retreating to steady my footing... Hold the path, {lord}.

elekid_line.text: Bzzap...! Ow! Blew my own fuse on that one...
Tch, running on empty! Cover for me while I recharge, {lord}!

torchic_line.text: Chirp...! Ouch! My embers just sputtered right out...
I'm sorry, {lord}... I'll warm back up on the sidelines, okay?

chimchar_line.text: Yowch...! Landed wrong... Even my tail flame's shrinking!
Heh, pushed my luck too far. Catch you after I patch up, {lord}!

bellsprout_line.text: Ghk...! Bent clean sideways... Roots aren't holding!
Shrinking back into the shade, {lord}. Don't let them trample the line.

oddish_line.text: Eep...! Ow, my leaves... Everything's going dim...
I'm tucking back into the dirt for a minute... Be careful, {lord}.

cleffa_line.text: Oh...! Seeing real stars now, and not the pretty kind...
I need to sit down before I topple over... Stay strong, {lord}!

igglybuff_line.text: Boing... oof! Lost all my bounce on that hit...
My voice gave out... Cheer loud enough for both of us, {lord}!

vanillite_line.text: Brrr...! Hey, I'm melting out here! Too dizzy...
Pulling back to chill out before I puddle, {lord}...

swinub_line.text: Snort...! Oof, right on the snout... Can't smell straight...
Burrowing back to camp for a quick breather, {lord}.

sewaddle_line.text: Ack...! They tore right through my collar stitch!
I need to slip back and mend myself up, {lord}. Watch your seams!

poliwag_line.text: Blub...! Whoa, my swirl's spinning the wrong way...
Can't keep my feet under me, {lord}. Pulling back to dry off!

magnemite_line.text: Bzz-krrt... Structural fault detected. Magnetics failing.
Disengaging for emergency recharge. Proceed with caution, {lord}.

nidoran_m_line.text: Grr...! Stupid hit... My ears are ringing!
Fine, I'm backing off before I pass out! Make 'em pay, {lord}!

nidoran_f_line.text: Ngh...! Took the brunt of that one... Can't hold them back anymore.
I'm stepping out of the front line, {lord}. Keep everyone else safe.

hoppip_line.text: Whoa...! Caught in a nasty downdraft... I'm tumbling!
Drifting back to softer grass, {lord}... Don't blow away without me!
